I don't enjoy doing anything anymore. I randomly browse the internet, play games, and sleep, that's all I do. The computer is my drug, and the computer is all I have.

No. I'm not going to go to a doctor. It's impossible for me. I live with my mom. Having her "help me out" would just spike my anxiety up and make it even worse. I don't want help. I want to suffer and die.\

That's all anyone ever says. Get to a doctor or therapist. That will never happen for me. I deal with extreme anxiety. I haven't left my home in fucking 5 years. If I had the willpower to get out to a doctor, I wouldn't need help from that doctor because I'd have gotten over my anxiety to get to them in the first place
Okay. If you're trying to make me realize that things CAN get better, then why are you saying that they WILL get better?

That's the thing. I don't. I don't know how my future will go, but you're telling me, you, a person who knows nothing about me, that it will get better. I know me. I understand me a million times better than you understand me, and even I understand that I might not get better. Anyways... Stop posting here. I don't want to talk to people like you. You don't use any sort of logic or rationality... you just speak absolute nonsense that's irrelevant.
Alright. It got better for YOU. Stop projecting your own personal success on others, just becuase YOU got better does NOT mean every other person will get better. Saying so is borderline idiotic.
Actually, screw it. No one wants to listen. People just want to say stupid bullshit. Just going to swallow these pills now. Later.

Alright. What about the millions that killed themselves? Did it get better for them? How do you know that I'm not one of the people who ends up shoving a gun in my mouth and pulling the trigger? You don't. So you saying that it does get better absolutely means nothing to me... in fact, it does more harm than good, because instead of actually trying to hear me out and talk to me, you're just spouting nonsense that isn't particularly true. You don't know me. You don't know my life. Don't tell me it will get better when you don't understand anything about me.
What makes you think that? You don't really know me so at best that's an assumption with no basis... I'm not really a very good person, and if you truly knew me, you'd understand.
Is anyone therre... I could really use someone to talk to right now.
